purpose: Machine-readable specification for all future Aethelgard language entries.
translation_rules: Do not invent a translation for an unknown canonical word.
Prefer phrase-level mappings when English/Common has no exact one-word equivalent.
Do not flatten culturally specific concepts into generic English when an explanatory gloss is needed.
Maintain separate native-script and romanized fields when the Veyrath glyph system is finalized.
quality_checks: Does the word have a unique semantic identity?
Does it avoid accidental Common resemblance?
Does its grammatical role make sense?
Does it belong to a defined register?
Does it duplicate an existing word unnecessarily?
Does it create useful vocabulary diversity?
